caption:
Namma Chocolate Recipe 
lets make your favourite namma chocolate at home! 
Got any questions? Drop a comment or DM me :) 
Ingredients: 
-112 grams chocolate ( i used equal quantities of callebaut 811 and lindt 70%)
-130 grams heavy cream, i use amul blue packet
-10 grams butter, i prefer salted
-cocoa powder, for dusting, I use van houten 

Add one: 
-10 ml of brandy or cognac ( reduce same Amt of cream)
-nuts, seeds, candy, whatever your heart desires :)

Method:
-heat your cream in a saucepan or microwave till hot
-add your chocolate + butter in a bowl and top with the hot cream, cover and keep for 4 minutes
-stir together to combine
- add it to a small dish i use a 3*6 dish and place in the fridge for 3-4 hours till firm
-remove the mix and cut into cubes and dust with cocoa powder
-store in an airtight container in the fridge
